summary: Iter 54 urgent-fix regression: all 3 fixes verified. Backend pytest 9/9 pass (jarvis 503+SSE error JSON, sos-keyword empty→400 and never sos_detected=true when LLM down, geo/locate GPS reverse-geocode, ip fallback for new user, briefing never 'New York'). Frontend UI verified end-to-end on mobile viewport: (a) angel-sos tap does NOT navigate — label switches to 'HOLD 1.5 S'; long-press 1.7 s navigates to fall-verify-screen; fall-im-ok cancels. (b) /jarvis morning briefing shows city 'Kosice' from prior GPS, then 'Singapore' after tapping jv-use-location (cloud egress IP), NEVER 'New York'. action_items: No code changes needed for these three fixes — all working as designed. Top-up the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget when convenient so live Jarvis chat/briefing text can be validated against real gpt-5.4 output (the fallback template briefing text is currently in use).
critical_code_review_comments: geo.py: DEFAULT_GEO retains 'New York' coords only as a last-resort seed; geo_resolved() correctly excludes 'default' and 'ip-fallback' sources so _weather() returns None instead of a spurious NY forecast (routes/agent.py:255). Good pattern.

agent.py: /agent/chat catches provider errors and re-raises via ai_http_error → 503 with readable detail; /agent/chat/stream emits {'error': ai_error_message(e)} JSON as the first data frame (routes/agent.py:1013). Frontend errMsg() unwraps '503: {"detail":...}' — clean end-to-end path.

lens.py voice_sos_keyword: relies on Whisper transcription — with LLM budget exhausted every call returns 502 (Transcription provider failed) and never returns sos_detected=true. Verified. Consider mapping the STT failure to 503 (like ai_http_error) for consistency with /agent/chat.
seed_data_creation: New geo-test dev-bypass user created per-run (email geo-test-<rand>@example.com) — safely isolated to test DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is EXHAUSTED — LLM calls correctly return 503 with 'AI budget exhausted …' detail; briefing text falls back to a deterministic template. All three iter-54 bug fixes are validated and stable. When the key is topped up, re-run test_iter54_urgent_fixes.py: the SSE stream test will start emitting real 't' text frames before the {'done': ...} meta (adjust assertion) and /agent/chat will return 200 with reply instead of 503.
